Product features

  • Modern Capsule Shape with Soft Backlit Design ：The rounded capsule shape and LED backlit glow create a clean, modern look, ideal for master bathrooms, guest bathrooms, vanity areas, dressing rooms, and salons.
  • 3 Color Temperatures for Different Routines ：Switch between warm, natural, and cool light to support makeup, skincare, shaving, grooming, and nighttime use.
  • Stepless Dimming for Customized Brightness： Long press to adjust the brightness smoothly, from soft ambient light to brighter task lighting based on your daily needs.
  • Smart Anti-Fog with 2-Hour Auto Shut-Off： The built-in defogger keeps the mirror clear after showers and automatically turns off after 2 hours for added safety and energy efficiency.
  • Memory Function Remembers Your Last Setting ：The mirror remembers the last brightness and color temperature used before turning off, making daily use faster and more convenient.
  • 5 mm Copper-Free Silver Glass for Clear Reflection ：The 5 mm copper-free silver glass provides a clear HD reflection with better moisture resistance and anti-oxidation performance.
  • Shatter-Resistant Backing Film for Safety ：The safety backing film helps hold glass fragments together in case of accidental breakage, making it safer for home bathroom use.
  • IP44 Waterproof, CRI >90, and UL Certified ：The IP44 waterproof rating is suitable for bathroom use, CRI >90 provides more accurate color rendering, and UL certification adds confidence for U.S. consumers.
  • Horizontal or Vertical Installation ：The mirror can be installed horizontally or vertically to fit different vanity sizes, wall spaces, and bathroom layouts.
